CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  September 9, 2025

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – September 9, 2025(Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – August 26, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the August 26, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the August 26, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-090
  • 2216 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Rudy Estrada
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign on an existing 1-
  story church building for a daycare associated with the church.
  1
  09/09/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-112
  • 910 East Main Street
  • Applicant: Sky Sam
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign on an existing 1-
  story commercial restaurant building known as ‘Mama Lu’s Dumpling
  House.’
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-082
  • 898 North Marguerita Avenue
  • Applicant: Wolfram Knoringer
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations and exterior
  re-painting of an existing 1 1/2-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  2
  09/09/2025
   •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

  AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-084
  • 801 East Pine Street
  • Applicant: Peter Thai
  • Request: This is an application for a new 408 SF first floor addition,
  1,040 SF second-story addition, and new attached 2-car garage to an
  existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. On the second floor, for the front facing windows, either
  reduce the window height or adjust their vertical position
  upward to prevent them from abutting the roof below.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

  3
  09/09/2025
 F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:31 P.M. to
  Tuesday, September 23, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
